Gamma scaled to 100M users and $100M ARR profitably, and AEO was one of their fastest-growing customer acquisition channels.

In the debut episode of Distribution, we sit down with Ravish Agrawal, who runs growth at Gamma.

He breaks down the exact playbooks Gamma used to dominate search and recommendations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews. Reddit, it turns out, is by far the most influential platform for winning ChatGPT citations.
